matching_config.description: Match the five experimental spin-1 sweeps and infer polarization from the complex lineshape. No TE calibration is required. These five scans are development examples, not a held-out performance benchmark.
matching_config.grid_source: Experimental set up details: signal scans use the same 500-bin frequency grid and n=1, 358.0 cm cable setup as the baseline example.
matching_config.hardware_hypothesis: Use the stated n=1 half-wave at nominal length 3.580 m, nominal coil and resistances, and zero shunt stray capacitance as an explicit first-model assumption. FIT the tuning capacitance and slow detector phase as in paper Eqs. 10-14. Other fixed component seeds remain assumptions, not new measurements. Do not inherit the previous bound-saturated baseline solution as known hardware.
matching_config.spin_hypothesis: Single-site deuteron Pake powder, complex absorption and dispersion, spin-temperature Q(P). No independent tensor enhancement assumed.

center_mhz.source: Initial position estimated from localized features; numerical search range on the confirmed acquisition grid.

split_mhz.source: Half-separation scale in the reduced-frequency Pake model; initial feature spacing, not a quadrupole calibration.

g.source: Lorentzian HWHM divided by splitting scale; numerical model-development interval.

eta.source: Single-site EFG asymmetry hypothesis; numerical interval, not measured material composition.

P_model.source: Polarization inferred by fitting the spin-temperature Pake branch shapes and their integrated intensity ratio; no TE calibration required.

log10_signal_scale_cgs.source: Log10 effective susceptibility amplitude with filling factor held nominal; not independent material calibration.

phase_slope_rad_per_mhz.source: Unknown slow detector-phase slope; explicit sensitivity bounds, not measured phase uncertainty.

phase_curvature_rad_per_mhz2.source: Unknown slow detector-phase curvature from paper Eq. 10; explicit numerical bounds, not a voltage polynomial.

log10_tune_capacitance_pf.source: Unknown tuning capacitor, fitted with an initial 50 pF scale close to the earlier fit. Search interval 10-2000 pF is numerical, not a measured tolerance.

acquisition.frequency_source: Repository owner: every baseline is timestamp plus 500 bins; retain the original proton sweep's bin offsets and spacing, replacing its nominal 213 MHz center with 32.7 MHz.
acquisition.derivation: f_j = (212.6 + 0.0015287*j) - (213 - 32.7) = 32.3 + 0.0015287*j MHz, j=0..499. The last sample is 33.0628213 MHz; 32.7 MHz is the nominal center, not the endpoint midpoint.

signal_parsing.timestamp_order: not strictly increasing; input order retained
signal_parsing.policy: Preserve every record and all 500 values; audit U+2028 and blank separators; no smoothing, rescaling or deduplication
signal_parsing.frequency_grid: Not stored in CSV; supplied separately as an acquisition contract

baseline_parsing.normalization: Strip outer whitespace; remove spaces/tabs only between a digit and decimal point; no other edits
baseline_parsing.field_convention: Field 0 is timestamp; fields 1..500 are sample indices 0..499
baseline_parsing.frequency_grid: Not encoded in this format; require separate acquisition metadata

fits.near_best_rule: Successful starts within 1% of minimum SSE; optimizer agreement, not a statistical confidence interval
fits.P_status: Spin-1 lineshape estimate; no TE calibration required. A fitted estimate is not an independent accuracy benchmark.

coverage.source: Controlled robustness exercise around jointly fitted experimental seed configurations. Half-ranges below are explicit teaching choices, not measured hardware uncertainties or a five-scan empirical population.
coverage.reference_source: Independent synthetic baseline averaged over 16 sweeps for the teaching exercise; not the acquisition's reported averaging count.
coverage.fixed_quantities: Frequency grid, n=1 branch, 3.580 m half-wave propagation scale, nominal sqrt(L/C)=50 ohm, G'=0, C_stray=0 and nominal filling factor. Vary effective susceptibility amplitude rather than two separately unidentifiable coupling scales. Recompute cable L/C together when conductor loss changes.

generation.label_source: New uniform draws in fractional P; fitted scan polarizations are NOT ground-truth training labels
generation.noise_model: White Gaussian reference with per-seed high-frequency sigma proxy
generation.units: Recorded units, NOT volts; no TE calibration or area normalization
limitations: Five development scans do not define a measured population distribution
White-noise reference does not reproduce all structured fit residuals or endpoint artifacts
All descendants of a source scan must stay together in experimental holdout splits
This 500-bin lineshape dataset is separate from the existing 512-bin TE-area teaching benchmark; use grid-aware preprocessing
Simulation test accuracy is not a measured experimental polarization uncertainty
